heading: Preservation of remedies
lead: Nothing in section 4041 or 4042 of this title shall be construed to preclude or limit any remedy otherwise available under other law, including consequential and punitive damages.

notes.text: Codification Section was formerly classified to section 597b of the former Appendix to this title prior to editorial reclassification and renumbering as this section.

sourceCredit: (Oct. 17, 1940, ch. 888, title VIII, § 803, as added Pub. L. 111–275, title III, § 303(a), Oct. 13, 2010, 124 Stat. 2877.)
